title: Brief producers to find and run tests that read the output they change
summary: Root cause: the producer brief never says to find existing tests that read the output being changed (status, plan, display text) and run them before reporting, so breakage surfaced only at the final verdict (jobs 20261111-105048-n7bm, 20261111-213010-8jgz). Fix by adding a section to the producer brief in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, with a test that fails without it. Retried jobs' candidates are dropped, not kept.

defaults_applied.how: A criterion tests the brief content by running the unit test.
fmt, clippy and test criterion included.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (producer_brief_with_evidence, checkable_evidence_section, replay_while_working_section, criteria_check_section); the change is a new brief section like those, no record files added so check_record_file/AnyRecord are unaffected.
Goal: producers, and the verifiers judging them, get early notice of broken existing tests; the fix is information in the brief, not a refusal rule.
The brief cannot know changed files at dispatch time, so the section instructs the producer to search for tests itself.
Only the producer role is targeted; no prompt files, athena.toml or defaults.toml change.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs adds a producer-brief section, emitted by producer_brief_with_evidence, that tells the producer: before reporting, Grep tests/ and #[cfg(test)] modules for text of any output it changes (status, plan, display), run those tests with cargo test -p <crate> --test <name>, then the full crate's tests, and cite the commands and any failing test name in its evidence.
A new unit test in briefs.rs asserts the producer brief contains this section for any reading; it fails on the base (run `cargo test -p athena-context briefs`) and passes with the change.
The section is given to the producer as information in the brief; no new refusal or gate rule is added, so the expected share of newly refused past readings is 0%.

Jobs 20261111-105048-n7bm and 20261111-213010-8jgz: their candidates (role_need.rs, status.rs, display.rs, introspection.rs, docs/spec.toml, status_build_measurement.rs) are dropped, not kept; their findings are about those features, not this cause. The drain flake in job 8jgz is out of scope.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and cargo test --locked pass.

out_of_scope: role_need.rs retire-candidate feature and later_similar_task feature from the earlier jobs
Fixing the drain parallel test flake
Adding a refusal or gate rule on producer reports
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml, CI workflows or prompt files
urgent_reason: It cuts failed and rejected attempts caused by existing tests broken by output changes and found only at final verdict.
hard_reason: It changes the producer brief in the run pipeline, which shapes how every job is produced.
